name: DL-methionine
description: DL-Methionine (CAS 59-51-8 ), also referred to as Hmet, is the racemic synthetic form of the essential sulfur-containing amino acid methionine. It functions as a nutritional supplement and precursor compound across feed, food, and pharmaceutical manufacturing. Controlled methionine supply is critical to formulation performance and biological efficacy in these industries. In animal nutrition, it is a primary feed additive for poultry, swine, and aquaculture, correcting deficiency in cereal-based diets. This additive supports growth performance and feed conversion in livestock. Pharmaceutical manufacturers use it as an active ingredient or excipient in tablet and infusion formulations targeting liver support and amino acid therapy. In food fortification, it is incorporated into protein supplements, clinical nutrition products, and functional foods. These applications ensure amino acid profiling meets defined dietary standards for human consumption. Personal care formulators apply it as an antioxidant and conditioning agent in hair and skin preparations. It helps protect formulations from oxidative degradation, maintaining product stability and efficacy over time. The product is supplied as a white crystalline powder or free-flowing granule. Granulated forms are often preferred for feed premix blending due to improved handling characteristics and reduced dust during processing. Standard grades include feed-grade, USP , and food-grade ( FCC ). These quality standards ensure the material is suitable for its intended application in highly regulated global markets. Bulk supply is available in 25 kg bags or bulk containers depending on specific application requirements.
